claims.statement: Finite spans of translated-scaled Hermite PhaseNav channels are dense in Schwartz space.
The Hermite kernel has the declared closed Fourier transform and Hhat_mn(0)=delta_mn.
PSD of every finite Hermite section plus continuity extends non-negativity to the dense core.
The finite Hermite ladder through basis size six is cutoff-audited and PSD-tested.
Binary complement is conjugate to reciprocal inversion in projective odds coordinates.
The unique positive reciprocal fixed point corresponds to p=1/2.
p=1/2 is the Fisher-Rao geodesic midpoint between the labelled pure states.
DEFINED_ZERO and UNDEFINED_BOTTOM are interpreted as informational boundary labels.
